description: Source code for Kubernetes cloud provider node controller, managing node initialization, labeling, and status updates with cloud provider integration.

classes.name: CloudNodeController
classes.description: Controller managing node lifecycle, labeling, and status updates with cloud provider support.

methods.name: NewCloudNodeController
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new CloudNodeController with provided informers, client, cloud provider, and worker counts.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Starts the controller, waits for cache sync, and launches worker routines.

methods.name: RunWithContext
methods.description: Runs the controller with context, managing event broadcasting, cache sync, and worker routines.

methods.name: processNextWorkItem
methods.description: Processes a single item from the workqueue, calling syncHandler and handling errors.

methods.name: syncHandler
methods.description: Handles synchronization of individual node resources based on key.

methods.name: UpdateNodeStatus
methods.description: Periodically updates node addresses and status from cloud provider data.

methods.name: enqueueNode
methods.description: Enqueues a node resource key for processing.

methods.name: reconcileNodeLabels
methods.description: Reconciles node labels transitioning from beta to GA versions.

methods.name: updateNodeAddress
methods.description: Updates the node's address information based on cloud provider data.

methods.name: syncNode
methods.description: Initializes or updates a node with cloud provider metadata and labels.

methods.name: getNodeModifiersFromCloudProvider
methods.description: Generates a list of functions to modify node objects with cloud provider info.

methods.name: getInstanceMetadata
methods.description: Retrieves instance metadata including provider ID, type, and addresses from cloud provider.

methods.name: getInstanceNodeAddresses
methods.description: Gets node addresses from cloud provider, using V2 if supported.
